verdict.rationale: Reducto Studio is documented as a web interface for testing parse/extract/classification workflows on real documents with a citation viewer before deploying as callable pipelines, which matches the spirit of a no-code playground. However, no evidence explicitly describes a drag-and-drop upload flow, and a community report from launch noted the Studio link (links.reducto.ai/studio) was broken with redirect errors, raising some doubt about polish/accessibility. Missing for 10: explicit drag-and-drop UI description, independent hands-on confirmation the playground works reliably today.
